turns.text: We're on holiday and I've had a nasty earache in my right ear since Tuesday, like 5 out of 10, hurts when I lie on it. I took some ibuprofen. My husband says my words have been coming out slurred this afternoon and my face looks lopsided, but I think I'm just tired from the flight. I'm 58, allergic to sulfa.
